verses.text: "If you will come back, Israel," says the LORD, "if you will come back to me, and if you will get rid of your disgusting idols and stop wandering away,
and if you will make your promises by saying, 'As surely as the LORD lives,' in a way that is truthful, fair, and right, then the nations will be blessed by him, and they will boast in him."
This is what the LORD says to the people of Judah and Jerusalem: "Plow up your hard ground, and do not plant among thorns.

Make yourselves pure for the LORD. Remove the hardness from your hearts, you people of Judah and you who live in Jerusalem. Otherwise my anger will break out and burn like fire because of the evil you have done, and no one will be able to put it out.
Announce this in Judah and tell it in Jerusalem: 'Blow the trumpet throughout the land!' Shout out loud and say, 'Gather together! Let us run to the walled cities!'
Raise the flag toward Zion! Run for safety! Do not wait! For I am bringing disaster from the north, a terrible destruction."
A lion has come out of his hiding place. A destroyer of nations has set out. He has left his home to make your land a wasteland. Your towns will be ruined and left with no one living in them.
So put on sackcloth. Mourn and cry out, for the fierce anger of the LORD has not turned away from us.
"On that day," says the LORD, "the king and his officials will lose heart. The priests will be shocked, and the prophets will be amazed."
Then I said, "Oh, Lord GOD! You have completely fooled this people and Jerusalem by saying, 'You will have peace,' when the sword is at our throats."

At that time this people and Jerusalem will be told: "A scorching wind from the bare hills of the desert is blowing toward my people. It is not a gentle wind to separate grain from chaff or to clean it.
It is a wind too strong for that, and it comes at my command. Now I will announce my judgments against them."
Look! The enemy comes up like the clouds. His chariots are like a whirlwind. His horses are faster than eagles. How terrible for us! We are ruined!
Jerusalem, wash the evil from your heart so that you may be saved. How long will you keep your wicked thoughts inside you?
A voice is announcing from Dan, announcing disaster from the hills of Ephraim.
"Tell this to the nations. Announce it to Jerusalem: 'An army is coming from a faraway land. They raise a battle cry against the towns of Judah.
They surround Jerusalem like men guarding a field, because she has rebelled against me,'" says the LORD.
"Your own ways and your own actions have brought this on you. This is your punishment. How bitter it is! It pierces you to the heart!"
Oh, my pain, my pain! I twist in agony! Oh, my aching heart! My heart is pounding inside me. I cannot keep silent. For I have heard the sound of the trumpet, the battle cry of war.
Disaster follows disaster. The whole land lies in ruins. Suddenly my tents are destroyed, my shelters in a moment.
How long must I see the battle flag and hear the sound of the trumpet?
"My people are foolish. They do not know me. They are foolish children who have no understanding. They are experts at doing evil, but they do not know how to do good."
I looked at the earth, and it was empty and without form. I looked at the heavens, and their light was gone.
I looked at the mountains, and they were shaking. All the hills were swaying back and forth.
I looked, and there were no people. All the birds of the sky had flown away.
I looked, and the fruitful land had become a wilderness. All its towns lay in ruins before the LORD, before his fierce anger.
This is what the LORD says: "The whole land will be ruined, but I will not destroy it completely.
So the earth will mourn and the heavens above will grow dark, because I have spoken and I have planned it. I will not change my mind or turn back."
At the sound of horsemen and archers every town runs away. Some go into the bushes. Some climb up among the rocks. All the towns are deserted. No one lives in them.

And you, ruined one, what are you doing? Why dress yourself in red and put on gold jewelry? Why paint your eyes with makeup? You make yourself beautiful for nothing. Your lovers hate you. They want to kill you.

I hear a cry like a woman in labor, a groan like a woman giving birth to her first child. It is the cry of the daughter of Zion gasping for breath, stretching out her hands and saying, "How terrible for me! I am fainting before the murderers!"
